name: Privacy-Preserving Browser Agent (PBA)
description: On-device visual perception + PII redaction. The browser is the privacy gatekeeper; only sanitized context leaves the machine.
//unlimitedStorage_note: Vendored neural weights (models/, see docs/VENDORING.md) exceed the 10 MB chrome.storage default; unlimitedStorage keeps them evict-safe. Weights are packaged in-extension, never fetched at runtime (CSP).
//host_permissions_note: captureVisibleTab in the multi-step agent loop needs a host permission. activeTab covers only ONE user-invoked action and lapses across the background loop — the symptom is "activeTab permission is required" on step 2+, or when the target tab isn't the focused tab. Scoped to web + local-file schemes (not <all_urls>) so it still can't touch chrome:// or the web store. For a zero-standing-permission posture, empty this and request these origins at runtime via optional_host_permissions from the popup's Run click (a user gesture).
